page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource sharing or CPU credit limitations, positioning the instance for workloads requiring sustained CPU performance.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance cost-efficient for compute-heavy workloads that do not require large memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
